test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the census of India 2011, which group of Union Territories of India has the highest literacy rate?

options.text: Andaman and The Nicobar Islands and Puducherry

solution:
The correct answer is **Lakshadweep and Daman and Diu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep** had the highest literacy rate among Union Territories in India as per the 2011 Census.
 
• **Daman and Diu** also featured prominently with a high literacy rate.
 
• The literacy rate is a crucial indicator of a region's educational and social development.
 
• The 2011 Census provided a comprehensive overview of literacy rates across various regions in India.
 
• Both Lakshadweep and Daman and Diu have implemented effective educational policies to achieve high literacy rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Indicator
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Literacy Rate**
 The percentage of people who can read and write in a given population.
 
 

 **Census**
 A systematic enumeration of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.
 
 

 **Union Territory**
 A type of administrative division in India, governed directly by the Central Government.
 
 

 **Educational Policies**
 Strategies and guidelines implemented by governments to improve education.
 
 

 **2011 Census**
 The 15th Indian Census conducted in 2011, providing extensive data on various demographic parameters.
